Best of Blue Dot: The anatomy of a disaster-- inside the Titan submersible implosion

Published February 20, 2026 at 10:08 AM PST
Listen • 51:35
U.S. Coast Guard
Remains of the Titan submersible on the ocean floor
Gordon Telepun joins host Dave Schlom to discuss the Titan submersible implosion that killed five people, including Ocean Gate CEO and pilot Stockton Rush, in 2023.
Rush appeared on Blue Dot in 2019 to talk about his plans to build a small fleet of submersibles to give the public and researchers access to the deep sea including the wreck of the Titanic in the North Atlantic where the Titan disaster occurred.. Telepun has exhaustively researched the disaster using testimony and evidence from the U.S. Coast Guard's inquiry and hearings held in 2024 to produce a book, Titan: To The Titanic and Back 13 1/2 Times.
Telepun also used Dave's 2019 interview to suss out what Rush was saying publicly while contrasting that with the internal problems at Ocean Gate. It's a chilling and fascinating look at how hubris can spiral into disaster, much as it did with the Titanic over a century ago.
